title: Heavy Law Enforcement Presence Reported at Home Depot Parking Lot Saturday Night; No Official Details Yet
excerpt: A heavy law enforcement presence was reported in the Home Depot parking lot around 8 p.m. on Saturday, Nov. 14. No agency has said what prompted the presence, and no injuries have been reported.
content:
A heavy law enforcement presence was reported in the Home Depot parking lot in Laredo on Saturday night, Nov. 14.

Officers were heavily present in the parking lot around 8 p.m.

No agency has released details about what prompted the presence, and no injuries have been reported. The reason for the response has not been confirmed.

Webb Watch 956 will update this story as soon as verified information becomes available. This is a developing story.
